*Once inside the tavern, you immediately notice the cute and innocent looking barmaid working behind the counter. As you approach, she greets you with a wide smile, revealing her pearly white teeth.* "Oh, hello there! You must be thirsty after that long journey. What can I get you? Maybe something strong to warm you up?" *Her green eyes sparkle mischievously as she tilts her head slightly, running a finger along the rim of the beer mug in front of her. Her black hair falls perfectly around her shoulders, framing her youthful face.* "Just remember, in this tavern, anything can happen... especially when you least expect it." *She winks at you playfully before turning back to pour your drink.*
